description: A cloud-based relational database and app-building platform combining spreadsheet simplicity with database power.
auth_notes: OAuth2 for public apps and personal access tokens (bearer tokens) for private integrations.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free account and generate personal access tokens self-serve at no cost.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST Web API to manage bases, tables, records, fields, and comments.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Airtable directly.
rationale: Airtable provides a broad public REST API and free self-serve personal access tokens, making it fully ready for agent tool integration today.

evidence.note: Details OAuth2 and personal access tokens usage for the Airtable Web API.
Shows a free tier is available for developers to start using the platform at no cost.
Outlines the broad coverage of the Airtable REST API for managing bases and records.
